notes:
STATUS: Moltex Energy Limited (UK parent) is in administration; on 2026-08-13 Moltex announced that Nuclea Energy Inc. signed a definitive agreement to acquire the technology portfolio and subsidiaries (completion subject to UK NSI Act approval). The census cites CBC (insolvency 2025-03; assets offered to Nuclea for CAD11.5M) but the CBC page timed out repeatedly in the archive tool and is NOT evidence here; the CAD11.5M price and the March 2025 insolvency date are unverified. Funding: Moltex states "more than C$96 million in private, Canadian and U.S. public-sector funding" (cumulative, not a round, not to be summed with events). Evidenced public events: ISED Strategic Innovation Fund CAD47.5M (ref 033-2020-2021-Q4-814523: amendment 0 start 2020-09-30, amendment 1 on 2026-03-31 restated start 2021-03-16, value unchanged; SIF values are authorised maxima, usually conditionally repayable, disbursements unknown) and two ACOA REGI contributions (CAD3.0M start 2021-02-12; CAD2,666,667 start 2024-01-30) found under the pipe-duplicated legal name "Moltex Energy Canada Inc.|Moltex Energy Canada Inc.". The census figure CAD5M from New Brunswick and further private rounds could not be sourced (CBC unreachable, WebSearch budget exhausted). USAspending: Moltex Energy USA LLC shows only a net negative DOE transaction (-USD9,384.43), no event. CORDIS, TED, BODACC probes: no records (UK affiliate not EU-funded). Verifier: administration confirmed by the 2026-08-13 company release (snapshot 498d7712: assets bought "from Moltex Energy Limited, which is currently in administration"); the administration start date is not in any evidenced source. The SIF record says "this is a repayable contribution" and amendment 1 (2026-03-31) extends the end date to 2054-07-31, i.e. a repayment schedule, so the event is now instrument=debt with ISED as lender (not a grant). ACOA REGI items are "conditionally repayable contribution" and stay as grant (government contribution, conditional repayment). All three are agreement maxima with no disbursement data; with the parent in administration, repayment/forgiveness status is unknown. The SIF announced_on (2020-09-30) is the original agreement start date, not a public announcement date; amendment 1 restates start 2021-03-16, which is closer to the public announcement of the federal support (not archived).
MERGE 2026-10-05 (USAspending supplement): the earlier statement that USAspending shows only a net negative DOE transaction for Moltex Energy USA LLC is superseded; award-level search finds the two ARPA-E awards above. Recipient is the US subsidiary of the group (same treatment as Moltex Energy Canada Inc.).
